note: OCT30-INFRA-S014: inputs of scripts/release-allocate.py, which derives the one fresh Pixel 10 (frankel) Beta candidate of a 'Build & publish latest Pixel 10' dispatch from its captured source. Each package lists every candidate-relative path its APK is built from; a package whose paths are unchanged since the previous release keeps its version (existing contract: unchanged Calculator and controller may stay equal), any change allocates a fresh versionCode above every consumed one. Over-inclusion only costs a version bump; a missing path would let changed bytes keep an old version, so paths are listed generously.
